Subject: Is ggplot available for R2.15 x64bit version?

Indeed, it should be available for all platforms by way of CRAN here
-- http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ggplot2/index.html and
consequently, by use of the install.packages() function in R.

Best,
Michael
